nimble.claim: Clay published changelog 'Product Roundup Week of October 5, 2026' on Oct 12, 2026: redesigned Clay home page with quick access to Workflows and chat, Audiences sources & exports view (export Audiences data via Workflows), and more accurate Clay Ads match-rate reporting aligned with each ad platform.

On Oct 8, 2026 at its Sculpt conference in San Francisco (2,000 attendees from 30 countries), Clay introduced a new agentic way to build in Clay (an agent that plans, runs and improves GTM plays against a Knowledge Hub record of your ICP), previewed Clay Workflows (visual play canvas, beta for all users, launching this fall), and launched the Inbound SDR Agent; the agentic product is available to Sculpt attendees immediately with broader early-access rollout in coming weeks.

Clay published changelog 'Product Roundup Week of September 28, 2026' on Oct 5, 2026: Workflow Budgets to cap credit spend per workflow, bulk re-run for Workflows, trusted domain access (one-click workspace joins for company-email teammates), Clay Ads in the CLI/coding agents, and a redesigned Audiences record details view.

On Sep 29, 2026 Clay launched the Clay Skills Marketplace (marketplace.clay.com), where users can find community-built GTM skills, free to install and ready to run in coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

On Sep 29, 2026 Clay published an Integrations Roundup changelog announcing 24 new and upgraded data integrations covering EMEA and APAC coverage, buying signals, new industries, enrichment, dialers, CRMs, and warehouses.

Clay published changelog 'Product Roundup Week of September 21, 2026' on Sep 28, 2026: Clay Ads company-list sync to LinkedIn with pause/edit/audit of recurring ad syncs, IP Access Restrictions for workspace members, clickable connection usage traces, and ~1-second workspace creation.
